title: Data Platform Engineer
description:
We are a fast-growing technology startup preparing new products for production. We're looking for a hands-on **Database Platform Engineer** to own our PostgreSQL databases on AWS end to end: keeping them fast, reliable and secure at high concurrency, building the data pipelines that feed them, and automating how they are deployed and changed. You'll work closely with our principal engineer and backend team, and your decisions will shape the platform as it scales.

Key responsibilities

**Database administration**

* Own PostgreSQL on AWS RDS / Aurora in production, including high availability, replication and failover.
* Design and test backup and point-in-time recovery to meet defined RPO and RTO targets.
* Tune performance using execution plans, pg\_stat\_statements and Performance Insights; manage indexes, partitions, vacuum and bloat.
* Configure RDS parameter groups and connection pooling (PgBouncer / RDS Proxy) for high-concurrency workloads.
* Plan and run zero-downtime schema changes, data migrations and major version upgrades.
* Review database designs from developers for performance, integrity and security.

**Data engineering**

* Build and maintain data pipelines (ETL/ELT, CDC) using Python, SQL and AWS services.
* Move data reliably between transactional databases, event streams and analytics stores.

**DevOps and automation**

* Provision and manage database infrastructure as code with Terraform or CloudFormation.
* Automate database deployments through CI/CD pipelines using Flyway or Liquibase.
* Set up monitoring, alerting and dashboards with CloudWatch and Grafana; lead incident response and root-cause analysis.
* Enforce database security: access control, encryption, auditing and secrets management.
* Automate routine operations with Bash and Python scripts.

Must-have skills

* 5+ years of hands-on PostgreSQL administration in production, including databases of 1 TB or more.
* Strong experience with AWS RDS or Aurora PostgreSQL: parameter groups, Multi-AZ, read replicas, snapshots and upgrades.
* Proven experience with backup, PITR and restore, plus performance tuning and lock troubleshooting under high concurrency.
* Experience delivering zero-downtime schema changes and data migrations.
* Infrastructure as code with Terraform or CloudFormation.
* CI/CD for database changes (Flyway, Liquibase, GitHub Actions, Jenkins or AWS CodePipeline).
* Strong SQL plus scripting in Python and Bash; comfortable on Linux.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Pay: ₹691,000.00 - ₹1,900,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance

Experience:

* PostgreSQL: 4 years (Required)
* aws rds: 1 year (Required)
* database migration: 1 year (Required)
* Performance tuning: 3 years (Required)
* DB parameter handling: 2 years (Required)

Location:

* Hyderabad, Telangana 500050 (Required)

Work Location: In person

title: Administrator (Support & Operations)
description:
Administrator (Support & Operations)

Hyderabad, Telangana

**Job Summary**
---------------

Job Summary Proactive approach to monitoring critical dashboards to report on critical alerts and guide all stakeholders to work together seamlessly and manage business critical incidents regardless of cause, size, location or complexity in order to mitigate business outage/impact. High collaboration and partnership is key to this role. The applicant should have strong understanding of the incident management process(as per ITIL standards) and handling major incident bridge calls. This position will act as an incident commander on major incident bridge calls and will be responsible and accountable to drive major incidents to resolution within the defined SLA\'s (Service Level Agreements). This highly visible role will interface with senior leaders in business. Analyst will also be responsible for resolving incoming telephone / email requests for technical assistance on standard commercial and proprietary applications. Documenting recommendations for troubleshooting and assuring issues gets resolved within the SLA. Analyst has to be knowledgeable of technical issues impacting organization and quality standards, and reporting requirements are core competencies of the position.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

Job Requirment: This role demands to be available 24\*7 for business-critical incidents, work in shifts. To independently resolve tickets within agreed SLA of ticket volume and time. Must be agreeable to work a flexible schedule to meet the needs of the business, including holiday, evening, overnight and weekend shifts As an incident commander you will be responsible for driving high-severity, high-visibility severity calls to closure within the defined SLAs. Based on the severity of the issue, which may be revenue - impacting, you will be required to engage with executives, vendors, Tier II Operations teams, and other product teams during the call. As a scribe you will be responsible for maintaining timeline of key events during a major incident. Documenting actions and keeping track of any follow up items that will need to be addressed. Monitor operational dashboards and alert the Product teams for action. Drive urgency based on application criticality. Assesses risk and manages activities affecting the production environment and client facing application availability. Deep understanding of Problem Management (as per ITIL framework) to capture CAPA. Principal Responsibilities: (Essential Functions) Exposure in handling and engaging vendors and vendor management Exposure to incident management process for cloud hosted applications environment Excellent verbal and written communications and the ability to work well with business and technical teams Event response experience with one or more ability to manage multiple activities at one time in a high-pressure environment Strength in building partnerships; working collaboratively with a variety of skills and levels Strong problem solving/analytical skills and strength in driving for business outcomes and results Strong technical, written, analytical and verbal communication skills Proven ability to prioritize, multi-task and adaptable to changing requirements and direction Must be technically literate and be able to articulate technical issues in a meaningful way to both engineers and executive level management. Knowledge Proactively seek and possess business acumen for all clients supported Maintain technical proficiency in all applications utilized by clients supported Participate in all company organized training events Contribute current technical information and best practices concerning proprietary applications to the C3i Reference Library or other knowledge distribution channel Organize and utilize all support resources provided including emails, documentation, contact lists, etc. Assist in the mentoring of Level I Analysts Backup role Be familiar with HD Supervisor functions and assume Supervisory responsibility in their absence

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

Job Requirements Skills Excellent verbal and written communication skills Strong interpersonal skills Basic understanding on platforms such as VMware, Networking, Linux & Unix, Windows Servers, Database, etc Problem solving skills, organizational skills, and the ability to exercise sound judgment in any customer service scenario Understanding of reactive case lifecycle and troubleshooting methodology with good understanding on applications such as ServiceNow, xMatters & Moogsoft. Education A Bachelor\'s degree in Business, Economics, Mathematics, Information Systems, Computer Science, or equivalent degree or work experience with ITIL Certified or equivalent Proficiency with ITSM tools like Service Now, Pager Duty, ITIL, IT Operations and Incident management

**Other Requirements**
----------------------

Working Relationships Maintain inter-department relationships to resolve client issues Effectively communicate with both internal and external clients Develop communication and working relationship with HD Supervisor Mentor Level I Analysts in their technical skill set

title: Web Server Administrator
description:
**About CleanHarbors**

  

Clean Harbors Inc. (www.cleanharbors.com) is a NYSE listed US based $6\.5 billion company. Clean Harbors was founded in 1980 near Boston by **Mr. Alan S. McKim**.

  

Everywhere industry meets environment, Clean Harbors is on\-site, providing premier environmental, energy and industrial services. Clean Harbors employs a dedicated workforce of 25,000 employees and has over 750 service locations across the U.S., Canada and Mexico. Beyond addressing the environmental needs of its more than 300,000 customers, the Company has been on the front lines of addressing some of the largest emergency response events in North America of the past several decades including the BP Oil Spill in the Gulf of Mexico, the anthrax attacks in New York, the 2015 avian flu outbreak that devastated the poultry industry, Hurricanes Katrina, Rita and Sandy, and the oil pipeline breaks that affected the Yellowstone and Kalamazoo rivers, along with other major chemical releases into the environment.

  

Clean Harbors India has been strategically established as the Global Capability Center (GCC) to serve our parent company. We take pride in serving some of the most tech savvy business stakeholders at Clean Harbors. The GCC employees form part of our globally integrated teams that provide cutting\-edge IT solutions and production support across platforms. Our shared services teams work seamlessly with their global counterparts in providing critical 24x7 support in various functions including Finance, HR, Procurement, IT and Operations. Our aggressive growth plans open significant career advancement opportunities for our employees.

 **Job Title: Senior Web Operations Engineer**

**Experience: 7\+ Years**

**Location: Hyderabad (Work from Office)**

**Working hours: 12\.00 PM to 9\.00 PM IST**

 **Summary**


Experienced Web Operations Engineer responsible for the administration, security, availability, and performance of enterprise web platforms and supporting infrastructure. Leads web server management, platform deployments, release coordination, and operational support across development, infrastructure, and security teams. Drives automation, process improvement, platform governance, and operational excellence while ensuring compliance with security and regulatory standards. Provides technical leadership, troubleshooting, and support for highly available production and non\-production environments.

* Administer, maintain, patch, and upgrade web servers and supporting infrastructure.
* Support development, testing, and production environments.
* Monitor platform health and proactively resolve operational issues.

**Release \& Change Management**

* Support scheduled production releases and maintenance activities.

**Security \& Compliance**

**Performance \& Reliability**

* Monitor application and infrastructure performance.

* Conduct capacity planning and recommend scalability improvements.
* Support HA/DR planning, testing, and operational readiness.

**Leadership \& Continuous Improvement**

* Support platform modernization and technology roadmap efforts.

**DevOps \& Automation**

**Database \& Integration Support**

**Leadership**
